home.hero_subtitle: Your luxury Mediterranean escape in Greece
home.concept_original_desc: Our original apartment offers an authentic Greek island experience with stunning sea views, traditional Mediterranean design, and all modern comforts. Located in a prime coastal position, it captures the essence of Greek island living.
home.concept_new_desc: Introducing Wavepoint 2.0 — a new floor with three beautifully designed apartments (Rooms 2.1, 2.2, and 2.3). Each space blends contemporary luxury with Mediterranean warmth, featuring premium finishes, panoramic sea views, and thoughtful amenities.

area.title: The Area
area.subtitle: Discover the beauty of our location in Greece
area.location_desc: Wavepoint Apartments are situated in one of Greece's most picturesque coastal regions. Surrounded by crystal-clear Aegean waters, stunning clifftops, and charming local villages, our location offers the perfect blend of natural beauty and authentic Greek culture.
area.beach_1_desc: A beautiful sandy beach just 5 minutes walk from the apartments, perfect for swimming and sunbathing.
area.beach_2_desc: A hidden gem accessible by a short trail, offering a secluded swimming experience.
area.restaurant_1_desc: Traditional Greek cuisine with fresh seafood and stunning sea views.
area.restaurant_2_desc: Authentic mezze and local wines in a charming garden setting.
area.activity_1_desc: Explore hidden sea caves and surrounding islands on a guided boat tour.
area.activity_2_desc: Discover breathtaking coastal views on our network of well-marked hiking trails.

about.title: About Wavepoint
about.subtitle: Our story, your paradise
about.story_desc: Wavepoint Apartments was born from a love of the Greek sea and a desire to share its magic with travelers from around the world. What started as a single apartment with breathtaking sea views has grown into a boutique collection of spaces, each thoughtfully designed to connect guests with the natural beauty of the Mediterranean.
about.story_desc_2: With the launch of Wavepoint 2.0, we're expanding our vision — bringing three new apartments to a new floor, each with its own character while sharing the same commitment to quality, comfort, and authentic Greek hospitality.
about.value_1_desc: We treat every guest as family, offering personal service and local insights that go beyond ordinary tourism.
about.value_2_desc: We are committed to eco-friendly practices, from energy-efficient appliances to locally sourced products.
about.value_3_desc: Every space is curated with care, balancing modern comfort with traditional Mediterranean aesthetics.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you
contact.form_success: Thank you! Your message has been sent.
contact.faq_1_a: Check-in is from 3:00 PM. Early check-in may be arranged upon request, subject to availability.
contact.faq_2_a: Yes, we offer complimentary private parking for all guests.
contact.faq_3_a: Pets are welcome upon prior request. Please inform us in advance so we can prepare accordingly.
contact.faq_4_a: All apartments include high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, a fully equipped kitchen, private terrace, and access to sea views. Pool access is available to all guests.
contact.faq_5_a: The nearest beach is just a 5-minute walk from the apartments.
contact.faq_6_q: Is there a minimum stay requirement?
contact.faq_6_a: During peak season (July–August), we require a minimum of 3 nights. For other periods, a 2-night minimum applies.
